text.name: Ring of Protection
text.description:
{Ring of Protection}

Gives all friendly targets +5% damage resistance.
text.event: You stared at how a crow was attacked by a sparrow guarding her nest. The poor crow circled this way and that, trying to fight off the annoying bird, and as a result dropped some object from its beak. Having picked it up, you realized that you had found the Ring of Protection.
